senses.gloss:
संधा €3 U.
—1 To join, bring together, unite, combine, put together, compound, mix;
 यानि उदकेन संधीयन्ते तानि भक्षणीयानि Kull.
—2
——(a) To treat with, form friendship or alliance with, make peace with;
 शत्रुणा न हि संदध्यात् सुश्लिष्टेनापि संधिना H. 1. 88; Cāṇ. 19; Kām. 9. 41.
——(b) To unite in friendship, reconcile,
[]
 make a friend of; सकृद्दुष्टमपीष्टं यः पुनः संधातुमिच्छति Pt. 2. 33.
—3 To fix upon, direct towards; संदधे दृशमुदग्रतारकाम् R. 11. 69.
—4 To fit to or place upon the bow (as a missile, arrow &c.); धनुष्यमोघं
 समधत्त बाणम् Ku. 3. 66; R. 3. 53, 12. 97.
—5 To produce, cause; पर्याप्तं मयि रमणीयडामरत्वं संधत्ते गगनतलप्रयाणवेगः
 Māl. 5. 3; संधत्ते भृशमरतिं हि सद्वियोगः Ki. 5. 51.
—6 To hold out against, be a match for; शतमेकोऽपि संधत्ते प्राकारस्थो
 धनुर्धरः Pt. 1. 229.
—7 To mend, repair, heal.
—8 To inflict upon.
—9 To grasp, support, take hold of.
—10 To grant, yield.
—11 To make good, atone for.
—12 To contract, close up.
—13 To approach, come near.
—14 To prepare, make, compose.
—15 To assist, aid.
—16 To comprehend, conceive.
—17 To possess, have.
—18 To perform, do; स्वलीलया संदधतेऽव्ययात्मने Bhāg. 7. 8. 41;
 वाङ्मात्रेणापि साहाय्यं मित्रादन्यो न संदधे Pt. 2. 12.
—19 To employ, make use of, apply to use.

—1 Union, association.
—2 Intimate union, close connection.
—3 State, condition.
—4 An agreement, a promise, stipulation, compact; ततार संधामिव सत्यसंधः
 R. 14. 52; Mv. 7. 8.
—5 Limit, boundary; यन्नस्त्वं कर्मसंधानां साधूनां गृहमेधिनाम् Bhāg. 6. 5. 42.
—6 Fixity, steadiness.
—7 Twilight.
—8 Distillation (for संधान q. v.). —9 Steady continuance in any state.
सांध a. Situated at the point of contact.
संधातृ m. N. of Śiva and Viṣṇu.

—1 Joining, uniting; वायुः संधानम् T. Up. 1. 3. 2.
—2 Union, junction, combination; यदर्धे विच्छिन्नं भवति कृतसंधानमिव
 तत् Ś. 1. 9; Ku. 5. 27; R. 12. 101.
—3 Mixing, compounding (of medicines &c.).
—4 Restoration, repairing.
—5 Fitting, taking an aim, fixing (as an arrow to the bow-string); तत्
 साधुकृतसंधानं प्रतिसंहर सायकम् Ś. 1. 11; अथाग्नियन्त्रसंधानविशेषोदग्रविक्रमान्
 Śiva B. 30. 1; Śi. 20. 8.
—6 Alliance, league, friendship, peace; मृद्घटवत् सुखभेद्यो दुःसंधानश्च
 दुर्जनो भवति H. 1. 88 (where it has sense 1 also).
—7 A joint; पादजङ्घयोः संधाने गुल्फः Suśr.
—8 Attention.
—9 Direction.
—10 Supporting.
—11 Distillation (of liquors).
—12 Spirituous liquor or a kind of it.
—13 A kind of relish eaten to excite thirst.
—14 Preparation of pickles.
—15 Contraction of the skin by means of astringents.
—16 Sour rice-gruel.
—17 Bellmetal (सौराष्ट्र).
संधानिका A kind of pickle or sauce.

संधानित a.
—1 United, strung together.
—2 Bound, tied.

संधानिन् a.
—1 Tying or binding together.
—2 Clever in taking aim.
—3 Distilling liquor.
संधानिनी A cow-house, cow-pen.

—1 Distillation.
—2 Braziery, foundry.
—3 The manufacture of spirituous liquors.
संधालिका A kind of food; L. D. B.

—1 Union, junction, combination, connection; संधये सरला सूची वक्रा
 छेदाय कर्तरी Subhāṣ.; Me. 60.
—2 A compact, an agreement.
—3 Alliance, league, friendship, peace, treaty of peace (one of the six
 expedients to be used in foreign politics); कति प्रकाराः संधीनां भवन्ति
 H. 4; (the several kinds are described in H. 4. 106-125); शत्रुणा न
 हि संदध्यात् सुश्लिष्टेनापि संधिना H. 1. 85.
—4 A joint, articulation (of the body); तुरगानुधावनकाण्डितसंधेः Ś. 2.
—5 A fold (of a garment).
—6 A breach, hole, chasm.
—7 Especially a mine, chasm or opening made by thieves in a wall or underneath
 a building; संधिं छित्त्वा तु ये चौर्यं रात्रौ कुर्वन्ति तस्कराः Ms. 9. 276;
 वृक्षवाटिकापरिसरे संधिं कृत्वा प्रविष्टोऽस्मि मध्यमकम् Mk. 3.
—8 Separation, division.
—9 Euphony, euphonic junction or coalition (in gram.)
—10 An interval, a pause.
—11 A critical juncture.
—12 An opportune moment.
—13 A period at the expiration of each Yuga or age; त्रेताद्वापरयोः
 संधौ Mb. 1. 2. 3.
—14 A division or joint (in a drama); (they are five; see S. D. 330-332);
 तौ संधिषु व्यञ्जितवृत्तिभेदम् Ku. 7. 91.
—15 The vulva.
—16 Distillation.
—17 Land etc. donated for the worship of temple-deities etc. (cf. Dr. ▪ Raghavanʼs note on
 वृत्तिसन्धिप्रतिपादकः Cola-Campū. p. 1 “संधिः
 देवपूजार्थमतिसृष्टं तादृशं भूम्यादिकं संधिपदस्य द्रविडदेवालयशिलाशासनेषु
 तादृशेऽर्थे व्यवहारदर्शनात् ।”).
—18 Contrivance, management; तस्य सावरणदृष्टसंधयः काम्यवस्तुषु
 नवेषु संगिनः R. 19. 16.
—19 Twilight.
—20 A seam.
—21 The connecting link of a perpendicular (in mensuration).
—22 The common side of double triangle.

संधिः + -अक्षरम् a diphthong.
संधिः + -काष्ठम् the wood below the top of a gable.
संधिः + -गृहः a bee-hive.
संधिः + -चोरः a house-breaker, a thief who breaks into a house.
संधिः + -छेदः making holes or breaches (in a wall &c.); as in संधिच्छेदशिक्षकः M. 4.
संधिः + -छेदनम् burglary.
संधिः + -जम् spirituous liquor.
संधिः + -जीवकः one who lives by dishonest means (particularly as a go-between).

संधिः + -दूषणम् violation of a treaty; अरिषु हि विजयार्थिनः क्षितीशा
 विदधति सोपधि संधिदूषणानि Ki. 1. 45.
संधिः + -नालः, -नालम् Unguis Odoratus (नख, क्षुर).
संधिः + -नालः, -नालम् Unguis Odoratus (नख, क्षुर).
संधिः + -पालत्वम् maintenance of treaties.
संधिः + -प्रबन्धनम् the ligament of a joint.

संधिः + -बन्ध
—1 the tissues of joints; Ś. 2.
—2 the cement or lime.
संधिः + -बन्धनम् a ligament, tendon, nerve.
संधिः + -भङ्गः, -मुक्तिः f. dislocation of a joint.
संधिः + -भङ्गः, -मुक्तिः f. dislocation of a joint.
संधिः + -मोक्षः the breaking of peace; Kau. A. 7.
संधिः + -रन्ध्रका a hole in a wall.

संधिः + -विग्रहः^1 m. du. peace and war. ˚अधिकारः the office of
 the minister for foreign affairs.
[1] Correction submitted by on 20260502. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-orig/commit/8ab1240.
संधिः + -विग्रहकः a minister presiding over the above.
संधिः + -विचक्षणः one skilled in negotiating treaties.
संधिः + -विद् m. a negotiator of treaties.
संधिः + -विपर्ययौ peace and war; दूते संधिविपर्ययौ Ms. 7. 65.

संधिः + -वेला
—1 the time of twilight.
—2 any connecting period.
संधिः + -शूलम् a kind of painful indigestion (आमवात).
संधिः + -संभवः a diphthong.
संधिः + -हारकः a house-breaker.
संधिकः A kind of fever.
सांधिकः A distiller.
संधिका Distillation (of liquors).

संधित a.
—1 United, joined; शपथैः संधितस्यापि न विश्वासं व्रजेद्रिपोः Pt. 2. 39.
—2 Bound, tied.
—3 Reconciled, allied.
—4 Fixed, fitted.
—5 Mixed together.
—6 Pickled, preserved (wrong for संदित; cf. Ms. 8. 342).
—7 Concluded (as an alliance).
संधिन् m. A minister of alliances.

—1 A cow in heat (united with the bull or impregnated by him).
—2 A cow milked unseasonably.

—1 A hole or breach made in a wall, pit, chasm.
—2 A river.
—3 Spirituous liquor.
—4 Loud orchestral sound of a band of musicians; L. D. B.

संधेय a.
—1 To be united or joined.
—2 Capable of being reconciled; सुजनस्तु कनकघटवद् दुर्भेद्यश्चाशुसंधेयः H. 1. 88.
—3 To be made peace with.
—4 To be aimed at.

संधुक्ष् €1 Ā. To be kindled or excited (fig. also); संदुधुक्षे
 तयोः कोपः Bk. 14. 109. ━Caus. To kindle, inflame, excite; निर्वाणभूयिष्ठमथास्य
 वीर्यं संधुक्षयन्तीव वपुर्गुणेन Ku. 3. 52; आतपान्तसंधुक्षितमदा V. 4.

—1 Kindling, inflaming; इतश्चेतश्च गच्छन्ती वैरसंधुक्षणे रता Mb. 3. 276. 16.
—2 Exciting, stimulating; रागिणस्त्यागशक्तिसंधुक्षणम् Dk. 2. 2.
संधुक्षित p. p. Kindled, inflamed, excited.

संधृ €10 U.
—1 To hold, bear, carry.
—2 To hold up, support, prop, sustain; अरैः संधार्यते नाभिः Pt. 1. 81.
—3 To curb, restrain, check.
—4 To keep in mind, retain in memory; यः सततं परिपृच्छति शृणोति
 संधारयत्यनिशम् Pt. 5. 92.
—5 To hold, have, possess; retain, keep; भृत्यः न स संधार्यो भूभुजा
 भूतिमिच्छता Pt. 1. 112.
—6 To observe, follow.
—7 To bear, suffer, endure.
—8 To survive, remain alive.

संधारणम्, -णा
—1 Restraining, checking.
—2 Observing, following.
—3 Suffering, enduring.
—4 Refusal (of a request).

संधारणम्, -णा
—1 Restraining, checking.
—2 Observing, following.
—3 Suffering, enduring.
—4 Refusal (of a request).

संध्य a.
—1 Being on the point of junction; संध्यं तृतीयं स्वप्नस्थानं तस्मिन्
 संध्ये स्थाने तिष्ठन् Bṛ. Up. 4. 3. 9.
—2 Based on संधि, euphonic combination.

—1 Union.
—2 Joint, division.
—3 Morning or evening twilight; अनुरागवती संध्या दिवसस्तत्पुरस्सरः ।
 अहो दैवगतिश्चित्रा तथापि न समागमः ॥ K. P. 7.
—4 Early morning.
—5 Evening, dusk; संध्यामङ्गलदीपिका विभजते शुद्धान्तवृद्धाजनः
 V. 3. 2; संध्याभ्ररेखेव मुहूर्तरागाः Pt. 1. 194.
—6 The period which precedes a Yuga, the time intervening between
 the expiration of one Yuga and the commencement of another; चत्वार्याहुः
 सहस्राणि वर्षाणां तत्कृतं युगम् । तस्य तावच्छती संध्या संध्यांशश्च
 तथाविधः ॥ Ms. 1. 69; अथासौ युगसंध्यायां दस्युप्रायेषु राजसु
 Bhāg. 1. 3. 25.
—7 The morning, noon, and evening prayers of a Brāhmaṇa;
[]
 उत्थायावश्यकं कृत्वा कृतशौचः समाहितः । पूर्वं संध्यां जपंस्तिष्ठेत्
 स्वकाले चापरां चिरम् ॥ Ms. 4. 93, 2. 69.
—8 A promise, an agreement.
—9 A boundary, limit.
—10 Thinking, meditation.
—11 A kind of flower.
—12 N. of a river.
—13 N. of the wife of Brahman.
—14 Any one of the divisions of the day (पूर्वाह्ण, मध्याह्न, अपराह्ण).

सांध्य a. (-ध्यी f.)
—1 Relating to the twilight or evening; सांध्यं तेजः प्रतिनवजपापुष्परक्तं
 दधानः Me. 38; Ki. 5. 8; R. 11. 60; Śi. 9. 15.
—2 Relating to the morning twilight or dawn.
संध्या + -अंशः the period at the end of each Yuga; Ms. 1. 69.
संध्या + -अंशुः twilight.

संध्या + -अभ्रम्
—1 an evening cloud (tinged with the sunʼs rays); संध्याभ्ररेखेव मुहूर्तरागाः Pt. 1. 194.
—2 a kind of red-chalk.
संध्या + -उपासनम्, -उपासना Saṃdhyā adoration; Ms. 2. 67.
संध्या + -उपासनम्, -उपासना Saṃdhyā adoration; Ms. 2. 67.

संध्या + -कालः
—1 the period of twilight.
—2 evening.
संध्या + -त्रयम् the three divisions of the day (forenoon, noon and afternoon).
संध्या + -नाटिन् m. an epithet of Śiva.
संध्या + -पयोदः a twilight rain-cloud.

संध्या + -पुष्पी
—1 a kind of jasmine.
—2 a nutmeg.
संध्या + -बलः a demon (राक्षस).

संध्या + -बलिः
—1 an image of bull in a temple of Śiva.
—2 the evening oblation.

संध्या + -मङ्गलम् an evening religious rite. ˚दीपिका an auspicious
 evening lamp; V. 3. 2.
संध्या + -रागः red-lead.
संध्या + -रामः (some take आराम as the word here) an epithet of Brahman.
संध्या + -वन्दनम् the morning and evening prayers.

संध्या + -समयः
—1 evening-time.
—2 a portion of each Yuga.

सांधिविग्रहिकः A minister (or Secretary of State) for foreign affairs
 (deciding upon peace and war).
